messages:
maria: Hey team — PR #482 just turned CI red but only the integration-matrix job failed. Can someone resubmit just that job and skip the image rebuild? Trying to avoid a full rebuild.

ci-bot: CI failed · PR #482 · integration-matrix (node12, ubuntu-20.04)
Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/482/1234 · exit code 1

maria: repro steps in the logs look like a timeout in e2e: `TimeoutError: element not found` — looks flaky not a build problem.

dave: For the quick path use the rerun CLI: 
```
ci rerun --jobs integration-matrix --skip-image-build
```
That will replay the job without triggering the container image pipeline.

sasha: Or from CI UI: open the workflow -> expand matrix row -> "Re-run job" -> choose "Run job without workflow" (skips images on our setup). Good if you don't have access to the rerun CLI.

maria: @dave I don't have the CLI on my machine. Can you run it for me? Or I'll use the UI.

dave: I can kick it. Running:
```
ci rerun --jobs integration-matrix --skip-image-build --pr 482
```

ci-bot: Rerun queued · integration-matrix · build 482-1235

oncall: Quick tip — if we see repeated flakes, bisect helps. Use `ci bisect --target integration-matrix --pr 482 --base main` to find when it regressed. But for one-off flakes the targeted rerun is fine.

sasha: Another safe flag if you're worried about cache is `--no-rebuild` instead of `--skip-image-build` depending on CLI version.

dave: rerun finished: build 482-1235 · integration-matrix · PASSED :white_check_mark:

maria: Awesome thanks! Marking the PR as green and merging. Will open a follow-up if it repros.

ci-bot: Build merged by maria · PR #482

maria: fyi for future reference I'm adding a short note to the PR about the retry command we used.

sasha: perfect — also add the bisect command snippet in case it becomes flaky again.

maria: done. Thanks all :heart:
